title: Count Robot Groups
summary: Robots start at strictly increasing positions and move right at their given constant speeds. Whenever adjacent robots or groups are within distance, they merge. Connected simultaneous merges form one group. A merged group uses the current position and speed of its rightmost member and never separates. Return the eventual number of groups after all possible merges.
officialConstraints: 1..100000 robots; positions, speeds and distance are between 1 and 1000000000.
Position and speed arrays have equal lengths; positions are strictly increasing.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
